int restore_xstate(struct xsave_struct *fx, u64 mask) {
    int err = 0;
    u64 xfeatures_mask;
    asm volatile(
        "1: "
        "xrstors %1, %0, %2\n"
        "2:\n"
        ".section .fixup,\"ax\"\n"
        "3: "
        "mov $-1, %0\n"
        "jmp 2b\n"
        ".previous\n"
        ".pushsection __ex_table, \"a\"\n"
        "    .align 8\n"
        "    .quad 1b, 3b\n"
        ".popsection"
        : "+r"(err)
        : "m"(*fx), "r"(mask)
        : "memory");
    return err;
}
